description: Return the message history of a single conversation, ordered newest first. Useful for catching up on a thread, summarizing, or extracting context before drafting a reply.

before.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only messages sent before this time.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: pass pagination.nextCursor from the previous page verbatim. Returns the next (older) page.

limit.description: Max number of messages to return (1-200). Default 50.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only messages sent at or after this time.

name: get_conversation_history
